svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from 3 mm acrylic: a floor 50 x 130, a long side 130 x 11

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the sides on top of the floor's edges, leaving the fourth

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long edge open: that edge welds to the chamber wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tray is 50 deep, 130 long and 14 tall outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: weld the open edge to the inside of the right wall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred under the Peltier opening, floor 127 above the inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor. Its top is 4 below the inner sink.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 6 mm drain hole in the wall is 8 above the tray's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: underside, just clear of the tray floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: water poured into the tray runs out of the drain hole.
